description: P37 (plan M6-M9 §2.13, §5.10, decision 27): who walks the Crownmarch's roads while the giant is there - at most two at once, one every 60-120 s, 120-220 m away, out of view, on a road node (never in a settlement, never by a placed fight that is not cleared). Each entry's members pay kill XP for its first three spawns only (wander.crownmarch.<entry>.spawns). The pike column marches the King's Road (a route through the road graph) from the toll fort to Kingsgate, neutral while Aldmere is at peace; the cavalry ride while Aldmere is hostile and Brannock's militia while the town is. The toll-riders' siege train of the plan's table (stage 6) waits for a siege-engine copy that pays nothing twice (docs/systems/P37.md).
